data: Advanced Creative Writing is a twelve-week course in which students expand on the skills they acquired in Introduction to Creative Writing. You will master the elements of fiction via workshops, one-on-one tutorials and multiple rewrites. You will wax eloquent about plot and dialogue (did someone groan at “action beats”?). You will talk craft and lyricism and resolution. You will finesse your voice and form. You will birth compelling characters in well-thought-out settings. You will continue learning the rules of writing and break them with aplomb. This is a painfully intensive course. Be prepared for double the reading and writing you did in Introduction to Creative Writing. At the end of the term you will produce two fully realized short stories, which, the professor realizes, is difficult to accomplish in three months. You, the student, need to realize this, too, and embrace the chaos of real-life publishing. There will be innumerable drafts, redrafts and deadlines. Each draft you produce will be up for your peers’ consumption. You will all work as editors to help make a story the best it can be. Zoom meetings with practitioners of fiction, editors and agents will further your understanding of the publishing world.
Assistant Professor of Practice, Creative Writing
